notes: RBox contraction (role chain) paired with mathematics-replace-0017: removes the chain 'is perpendicular to' followed by 'is parallel to' gives 'is perpendicular to' in a plane. Two different relations give a third, so it is a chain, not transitivity. Every prompt says the lines lie in one plane, because in space, under the convention that perpendicular lines meet, a and c can be skew. Instances use lettered lines, as the revision does. The first instance asks whether a is perpendicular to c (yes before), the second whether p could fail to be perpendicular to r (no); the cross-lingual queries ask the first instance. The not query states the removal's opening (no). Side facts about even numbers are copied from the revision. Unrelated near asks another mathematical chain (equals followed by less than gives less than). hops counts the instance facts in the prompt as the bridge (1 + 1).
